goal: Complete and exercise the bounded workspace-local autonomous prompt-text loop through native DSH Codex services, independent grading, activation and rollback.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Native subscription calls use fixed tool-free DSH services with bounded outputs and usage receipts, without copied credentials or profile mutation.
Exact campaign authority and separate service-mount approval are enforced before native operations; expiry, scope, revocation, runtime drift and allocation denial stop execution.
Baseline execution, native hypothesis and candidate generation, development and qualification evaluation, selection, activation and canary compose without per-candidate intervention.
A fresh request consumes the promoted prompt and a fresh post-rollback request consumes the prior prompt; automatic failed-canary compensation is covered separately.
Completed operations resume without duplicate sends, pending effects are not resent, concurrent supervisors are excluded and derived task scores are revalidated.
Generated text has no execution or filesystem capability; expected results never reach the model and qualification inputs never reach the generator.
Focused tests, the complete repository gate, isolated dependency graphs and the eight-package consumer smoke pass.

outcome.summary: The bounded native text loop is implemented and a separately approved pilot completed generation, grading, promotion, canary, active-generation consumption and explicit rollback. General executable-harness evolution is outside this scope.

what_worked: The corrected native campaign completed twelve requests with no pending intents; its generated prompt passed all four development and qualification cases plus the canary.
Fresh native calls proved consumption of the promoted prompt and restoration of the prior prompt after rollback.
Budget exhaustion and revocation denied additional operations before native dispatch.
Separate native and legacy package graphs resolved their incompatible service versions without upgrading historical v0 behavior.
The final repository gate passed 1239 tests with seven explicit integration skips, and eight release tarballs passed clean-consumer verification.
what_failed: An initial dependency layout selected an incompatible newer LLM service for legacy sandbox imports; isolated packages and explicit peer pins corrected it.

The first native attempt rejected the existing credential metadata because the adapter expected an oauth tag rather than the native grant tag. It stopped before model dispatch; its failed receipt and consumed allocation remain intact.
An existing CLI help assertion required preserving the confined-verifier boundary wording; the wording was restored before the final passing gate.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: An incorrect native credential discriminant stopped the first campaign before model dispatch.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Use the native metadata types and preserve the regression test; never infer credential formats from naming.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Mixing native and legacy DSH service versions broke an import boundary.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Keep native service peers isolated and verify the clean-consumer dependency graph.

evidence.summary: Version-pinned native pilot evidence records the failed first attempt, twelve successful requests, independent task outcomes, automatic activation, fresh active and restored generation calls, budget denial and revocation.
Fourteen synthetic-transport tests pass, including the post-pilot final-retention authority recheck and revocation compensation.
Eight native protocol and credential-metadata tests pass without real credentials or external calls.
The reviewed contract defines the text-only capability boundary, human campaign scope, separate native mount, bounded allocations and private artifact handling.
The final gate passes 1239 tests, seven opt-in skips, typechecking, all builds, reviewed capsule pins, policy checks and both offline scorecards.
Eight built package artifacts passed clean-consumer imports, CLI runtime assets, package resolution and complete offline campaign replay. Registry publication was not performed.

uncertainty.statement: The pilot uses synthetic comparison tasks and a deliberately weak seed; it does not measure improvement of the existing research workspace.
uncertainty.resolution: Prepare a representative, separately authorized reporting or research-workflow campaign with independent qualification and transfer evaluation.

uncertainty.statement: The exact native pilot precedes an additive final-retention authorization recheck. That revocation edge is covered synthetically; no further native calls were made after the allocated pilot.
uncertainty.resolution: Use the recorded runtime identity for historical native claims; exercise the additional edge in a future separately scoped native campaign if needed.

uncertainty.statement: Forced OAuth-expiry refresh and arbitrary generated-code OS isolation were not exercised; neither is claimed by this text-only pilot.
uncertainty.resolution: Test those integrations separately before expanding the supported execution surface.

notes: The maintainer explicitly approved the exact installation, both native campaign attempts and host mounts, and the updated contract/capsule sources. Broader code review remains pending.
